description: Use this when the person asks how an employer's postings come and go: whether roles come down or sit open, how long they stay open, any recent layoffs filing. It does not judge whether the employer is hiring. Per companyToken (up to 20), as the site prints it: open_roles, tracking_days, feed_total and, where its gate admits them, filled_roles_90d (taken down, not re-listed), relisted_roles_90d (a floor), median_days_to_fill (stated dates, lower bound); gate names why not. A takedown is not a hire — a filled role, a cancelled one and a withdrawn one look identical from here; it is one BOARD, never summed across an employer's boards, never a headcount; a token two hiring systems share gets none. No closure observed is record:'unknown' with a reason, never a verdict: on a board bigger than one visit can read, no closure is observable to us until we complete a provable full pass and then watch a role go after it. layoff_filing: the newest US WARN notice or SEC 8-K Item 2.05 filing (filer verbatim, dates, count, link), read hourly from EDGAR and nightly from state notices, null if none within 90 days; see layoff_basis.

companyTokens.description: companyToken values from job cards or search_jobs (a vendor tenant, e.g. 'acme' or 'gici~wd5~Careers'). Up to 20; more is refused with the count named.
